case.name: window_frame_after_update
case.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(x) FROM (SELECT sum(x) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY seq ASC ROWS BETWEEN 32 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS x FROM (SELECT length(t.payload) AS x,t.seq AS seq,t.grp AS grp FROM t WHERE (t.grp=36 OR t.seq%32=0) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u WHERE u.id=t.seq AND u.v>=t.v)));
case.prepare: UPDATE t SET v=v+1 WHERE seq%32=0;
